title: Lumen · Web Platform Tests
phase: Repairing one upstream image regression before acceptance
score_note: Whole-platform goal remains unverified. Historical coverage and focused regression results are reported separately.

historical.label: Historical multi-revision WPT-only results; not fresh validation
historical.comparison: Chrome 158.0.8116.0 Linux wpt.fyi, 2026-10-21; Lumen results span revisions

coverage: WPT testharness: 30,284 observed of39,356 Chrome-reference URLs; matched Chrome-passing assertions91.40%, completely matching clean URLs37.25%. Test262 is reported separately. Reftests, WebDriver and other uncovered automated categories count as unverified. The inherited run and current candidate are not yet fresh accepted results.
findings: Accepted core db088f4: +528 matched WPT assertions across 23 URLs, zero lost prior passes, and native suite 105/105.
Iteration 9 is not accepted: the independent image gate gained two assertions but lost one previously passing cached-image empty-picture case. A bounded repair is in progress.
The durable image fixture passes 15/15, but it did not cover the exact upstream cached-image timing; that reproduction is being added to the gate.
Editing passes 59 exploratory native/React assertions and permanent 37 native plus 4 React assertions. Expanded upstream selection results match canonical 792/807.
The pointer discrepancy also occurs on the starting version and was traced to testdriver multi-click counting; it is tracked separately from the editor engine fix.
Android iteration 9 is an exploratory toolchain build only. Final device acceptance and the unchanged 360-URL replay will use the repaired immutable candidate.
Grid experiment remains parked after 28 expanded-gate regressions. Whole-platform coverage and the signed-in ChatGPT session remain unverified.
